messages:
Alex M: PR #8424 ready for review — updates SDK snippets for streaming + pagination (py/ts/go). Fixes cursor-loss during retries on transient 429s. CI failing on gofmt only. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8424
Samira K: Nice. Do we have a deterministic unit mock for the 429+resume case? Integration would be flaky.
Alex M: Added py/tests/test_stream_retry.py mocking first-chunk 429 then resume; ts/go have similar unit mocks. Also added short README example for retry_then_resume pattern. Python snippet:
```python
from redwood import StreamingClient
client = StreamingClient()
stream = client.stream("gpt-open")
for chunk in stream.retry(max_attempts=3):
    if chunk.type == 'cursor':
        state = chunk.cursor  # preserve cursor across retries
        continue
    print(chunk.text)
```
Chris R: For TS, use stream.close() instead of deprecated stream.cancel(). Also update doc anchor to https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk#streaming — current link goes to old anchor. I can PR the anchor fix.
Lina P: Alex, add a migration note about preserving cursor state during retries and a gofmt pre-commit check. CI shouldn't block merge just for formatting — suggest auto-fix step.
Alex M: Pushed commit with migration note and test. @Docs Bot run render-docs for PR.
Docs Bot: render-docs started for PR #8424 — preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/8424 (queued)
Kevin T: LGTM after preview. One nit: example sets max_attempts=3 but default is 5; add comment explaining choice (lower for interactive latency).
Chris R: I'll add a tiny CI step to run gofmt -w and fail if diffs remain. Follow-up patch incoming.
